subject: docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v32.json
head: 9c9275f92a4d57f1a86efdd6d67bdda7da6d1f66
scopeOfReview: Stage A adversarial review of g21-fixture-corpus.v32 as a leftover-design authoring candidate for per-D-002-platform copies of the D-356 CC-5 invalid-UTF-8 payload (G21.cc5.invalid-utf-8). Refutation-first. This review binds nothing, records nothing, SATISFIES nothing, remasures nothing, and does not close leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING.
methodNote: Findings were isolated by structural triangulation against two predecessors rather than by clause-by-clause plausibility. g21-fixture-corpus.v31 (D-356) is the same-payload, different-act predecessor: it first-authored the source injection and authored no copies. g21-fixture-corpus.v30 (D-354) is the different-payload, same-act predecessor: it authored four per-D-002-platform copies of the D-352 truncated-body payload and is the exact structural analogue of the candidate. Any clause the candidate inherited from v31 that v30 does not carry is a clause belonging to an injection-only corpus and wrongly retained in a copies corpus. All four MUST-FIX findings are un-retargeted carry-forwards of that shape. The mechanically recomputable parts of the candidate are clean: every cited digest, every quoted contract clause, the platform quoting, and the authored bytes verified without exception. The defects are confined to tokens a clone must advance by hand.

findings.title: The candidate asserts its own stated failure condition
findings.text: failsIf[26] reads "per-D-002-platform copies are claimed authored by this speaker". The candidate claims exactly that. whatIsAuthored opens "Four platform-indexed copies of the D-356 G21.cc5.invalid-utf-8 payload."; summary.platformCopiesAuthored is true; summary.authoredFiles is 4; authoredCatalog.members[0].copies enumerates four platform-indexed copies; and the four files exist on disk at 0444 with the source payload digest. The document therefore states a condition under which it fails and then satisfies that condition on its own bytes. Recording this artifact would record a candidate that declares itself failed.
findings.evidence: g21-fixture-corpus.v30, the structural analogue that likewise authored four per-D-002-platform copies, carries no such failsIf entry. g21-fixture-corpus.v31, which authored the source injection only and authored no copies, does carry it verbatim. The clause is an un-retargeted carry-forward from v31 into a corpus whose central act it forbids.
findings.repair: Delete failsIf[26]. It has no counterpart in the accepted copies-corpus predecessor v30.

findings.title: "Does not author per-platform copies." is false on the candidate's own bytes
findings.text: doesNot[19] reads "Does not author per-platform copies." The candidate authors four per-D-002-platform copies. This flatly contradicts whatIsAuthored, authorityClaim ("PROPOSES leftover-design per-D-002-platform copies of the CC-5 invalid-UTF-8 injection recorded at D-356"), summary.platformCopiesAuthored true, summary.authoredFiles 4, authoredCatalog.members[0].copies, findingDisposition.copyAct ("Four per-D-002-platform copies of G21.cc5.invalid-utf-8"), and the four files on disk.
findings.evidence: Same triangulation as MF-1: absent from v30 (copies corpus), present in v31 (injection-only corpus), retained unchanged in v32 while summary.platformCopiesAuthored was flipped from false to true and summary.authoredFiles from 1 to 4. A doesNot list is a list of acts not performed; this entry denies the act the artifact exists to perform.
findings.repair: Delete doesNot[19]. It has no counterpart in v30.

findings.title: A second, contradictory sole last-heading claimant is named
findings.text: basedOn.sarifLeftoverJoinV14.role ends "Not last-heading claimant; basedOn.d355.role is the sole last-heading claimant." The dispatch invariant is that basedOn.d357.role is the sole last-heading claimant, and the candidate asserts that twice elsewhere: purpose reads "basedOn.d357.role is the sole last-heading claimant." and findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody reads the same. The document therefore names two mutually exclusive sole claimants. It also contradicts basedOn.d355.role itself, which reads "Not last-heading. Last-heading custody remains D-357.", and basedOn.d357.role, which reads "Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only." Live COORD's last heading is D-357 (commit 9c9275f9), so d355 is the wrong claimant on live bytes as well as internally.
findings.evidence: This pointer tracks the then-current last heading in every accepted predecessor: v26 and v27 name basedOn.d351.role; v28, v29 and v30 name basedOn.d353.role; v31 names basedOn.d355.role. v32 should name basedOn.d357.role and was left at v31's value. This is the dispatch attack "basedOn.d357.role is not the sole last-heading claimant", sustained.

findings.title: The lineage-collapse guard points at the wrong pair, leaving the actual 32/32 collision unguarded
findings.text: The dispatch names one collapse hazard: "Do not collapse leftover-join.v32 of G21 with g21-fixture-corpus.v32." That is the real numeric collision at this turn, since the historical G21 leftover-join recorded at D-353 and the candidate corpus share the version number 32. The candidate never states that guard. failsIf[29] instead reads "leftover-join.v31 of G21 is collapsed with g21-fixture-corpus.v32" — a pair that no longer collides on any number — and doesNot[39] and failsIf[28] likewise still guard the currency of leftover-join.v31 of G21. failsIf[38] separately guards the v39 pair, which also does not collide. The one hazard the dispatch names is the one hazard left unguarded.
findings.evidence: The guard is demonstrably prompt-tracking in the accepted predecessors. The v31 dispatch said "Do not collapse leftover-join.v31 of G21 with g21-fixture-corpus.v31" and v31's failsIf carried exactly "leftover-join.v31 of G21 is collapsed with g21-fixture-corpus.v31". The v30 dispatch named the v30/v30, v29/v29 and v28/v28 collisions and v30 carried all three. In v32 the corpus side of the clause was mechanically bumped from v31 to v32 while the join side was left at v31 — a half-updated clone, which is itself evidence the retargeting pass did not run. This is the dispatch attack "leftover-join.v32 of G21 collapsed with g21-fixture-corpus.v32", sustained.
findings.repair: Add "leftover-join.v32 of G21 is collapsed with g21-fixture-corpus.v32" to failsIf and the corresponding doesNot line, and retarget or drop the stale leftover-join.v31 clauses at failsIf[28], failsIf[29] and doesNot[39]. Note the general disclaimer at basedOn.leftoverJoinV39.role ("g21 leftover-join and g21-fixture-corpus are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated") mitigates but does not substitute for the named guard, because it is attached to the one join whose number does not collide.

findings.title: The golden guard still names leftover-join.v32 of G21 rather than leftover-join.v35 of G21
findings.text: The dispatch requires "Do not remasure leftover-join.v35 of G21 as a golden" and lists "leftover-join.v35 of G21 remasured as a golden" among the attacks. The candidate carries no such clause. doesNot[11] and failsIf[25] instead guard "leftover-join.v32 of G21 ... as a golden", which was v31's requirement. doesNot[51] covers leftover-join.v39 of G21 as a golden and doesNot[54] covers leftover-join.v35 of G21's currency, but nothing covers leftover-join.v35 of G21 as a golden.
findings.evidence: The v31 dispatch said "Do not remasure leftover-join.v32 of G21 as a golden" and v31 carried exactly that, so the clause tracks the dispatch's named historical join, which at this turn is v35. Classified SHOULD-FIX rather than MUST-FIX because the attack is refuted on substance: basedOn.leftoverJoinV35.role holds it "Predecessor. Unmoved. ... Historical after D-357." and does not remasure it as a golden. The defect is the missing guard clause, not a false claim.
findings.repair: Retarget doesNot[11] and failsIf[25] to leftover-join.v35 of G21, or add the v35 golden guard alongside.

findings.title: The member's expected pass-property was dropped
findings.text: Both predecessors carry authoredCatalog.members[0].expected, the member's stated pass property. v31 reads "RF-2 typed invalid-UTF-8 refusal. N=1 is in-bound against the quoted preHandshake clause. The receiver must read the body. Body length equals claimed N=1. The body is not well-formed UTF-8 and is not a UTF-8 JSON text. Uncommitted candidates discarded." v30, the copies analogue, carries its own expected for the copied truncated-body member. v32 has no expected key at any member path, so the authored member states no expected behaviour.
findings.evidence: Member key sets: v30 [id, class, inputCorpusId, byteLength, mutation, expected, payloadSha256, platformCopies]; v31 [id, class, inputCorpusId, path, sha256, byteLength, mutation, expected]; v32 [id, class, inputCorpusId, byteLength, mutation, sourcePayload, copies]. The drop is a regression against both. Retaining expected on a copies corpus is established by v30, so this is not a difference the copy act justifies. The accompanying key renames (payloadSha256 to sourcePayload, platformCopies to copies) are not themselves findings — the content is present and verified — but they reduce machine comparability against v30, which records the same act.
findings.repair: Restore authoredCatalog.members[0].expected, stating the RF-2 typed invalid-UTF-8 refusal pass property as v31 did for the same payload.

attacksRun.attack: quoted contract clauses are paraphrased rather than quoted
attacksRun.evidence: All five controlFrameEncoding quotations — frame, preHandshakeBoundQuoted, postHandshakeBoundQuoted, cc5IntentQuoted and encodingQuoted — occur verbatim in live control-protocol-contract.v2. g21OccupancyV4PassPropertyQuoted matches occupancy v4's passProperty. 65536 and 16777216 are quoted from those clauses, not invented; 26214400 is not introduced.

attacksRun.attack: the authored bytes do not witness invalid UTF-8, or duplicate the D-352 truncated-body member
attacksRun.evidence: The payload is 0000000180: N parses to 1 and the body is exactly one octet, so body length equals claimed N and the frame is complete, correctly excluding truncated-body. 0x80 lies in the UTF-8 continuation range 0x80–0xBF and cannot start a well-formed sequence, so the body is not a UTF-8 JSON text as required by the verbatim-quoted encoding clause. N=1 is the minimum positive value of the quoted 4-byte big-endian unsigned encoding, neither 0 nor greater than 65536, so EV-5 oversize-from-prefix correctly does not apply. byteLength 5 matches the file. The D-352 truncated-body member at fixtures/g21.v22/ is 4 bytes with a distinct digest; doesNot[38] and failsIf[22] guard reuse and the guard holds.

corroborations: Every mechanically recomputable claim in the candidate verified without exception: 74 digest assertions across recordedInputs, basedOn, file08Pin and authoredCatalog; five verbatim contract quotations; the occupancy v4 passProperty quotation; the ORDERED-EQUAL platform quoting against two live harnesses; twelve predecessor review verdicts; seven basedOn commit-to-heading mappings; and the authored bytes themselves.

The copy act is correctly scoped: four directories under fixtures/g21.v25/ named by the D-002 tokens with slash replaced by dash, one file each, all 0444, all equal to the source payload digest, no Windows directory, and the frozen source at fixtures/g21.v24/ untouched.

The candidate correctly distinguishes reporting an upstream remasurement from performing one. leftover-join.v39 of G21 (D-357, dual ACCEPT 0/0) does remasure leftover-design of the D-356 injection stale as an authoring claim on its own live bytes, and the candidate attributes the act to v39 at basedOn.d356.role, basedOn.fixtureCorpusV31.role and findingDisposition.invalidUtf8Witness while reserving the copies' own staleness for a later remasurement.

The named open decision on prefix exactly at the operative bound is preserved rather than settled, and the far-over family's non-exhaustion nuance is carried into remainderAfterThisCorpus and findingDisposition.farOverFamily.

Header posture is lineage-consistent with v30 and v31: DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE, CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, DO-NOT-SEAL, binds NOTHING, file08StatusToken OPEN, requiredNowUnchanged 28.

The four MUST-FIX findings are all clone-retargeting defects, not errors of measurement or judgement. Repairing them is textual and touches no byte of the authored payload or copies, no digest, and no quotation.
